notes.title: Quick Fix #5
notes.content:
Fixed

 Bug where level could be completed with wrong answer supplied.
 Problem where some level answers could be guessed.
 Bug where boxes would get stuck at Splitters and Writers.


Added

 Indicators to show what connections are valid when dragging a 'Logic Link'.

notes.content:
